notes.title: DRL SIM 4.1 Release Announcement
notes.content:
Hello Pilots,

In this release you will find a new map to explore! Silicon Valley brings you an epic soccer stadium, with lively surroundings, gaps, and dives galore. With this map comes the Race in the Cloud track, as well as 4 alternate tracks of different difficulties.

We've also brought to the playing field an update to Pro Pilot mode (Pro Mode + Damage), a crash/shake animation upon impact and crash/impact audio. Also, the ability to adjust the drone trail width while spectating and watching replays. You will now have a Damage symbol in Multiplayer races on the race order panel when another player sustains damage. The crash systems sensitivity has been updated to provide a better experience upon impact.

Tournaments now allow you to go back to previous tournaments and see the entire bracket, check results and replays!

Additional improvements/updates, including:
- 2 new Draganfly drone skins and 4 new Draganfly motors to customize your drone
- 2022-23 Virtual Season tracks
- Opponent bot auto-refresh
- Adjustable intro music via the Settings menu (music volume option)
- Ability to Favorite track on post-race screen
- Added an Exit button to the game footer
- XP has now been added to the Achievements completion
- New Replay markers (checkpoints, crashes, and mid-lap)
- Chat improvements
- Track Editor improvements
- Map improvements (lighting and performance)

Most notable bug fixes:
- Tournament registration issue
- Uncapped Racer4 exploit
- Damage on Racer4 custom physics
- Nano Class Leaderboards
- And many other fixes and improvements

We love hearing all feedback and suggestions, so please let us know what you think of this release!

notes.title: DRL SIM 4.0 Release Announcement
notes.content:
Hello Pilots,

We're really excited to share our latest updates with you! The development team has been grinding to bring you a new Onboarding mode, a new Search & Destroy game play mode, a DRL Pilot flight mode, upgraded Replay system, and an irresistible new Mega City map with three (3) brand new tracks! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29022929/1826cb3e0bc1762801b50d6628102acd1cb3518d.jpg
The new Mega City map features a futuristic metropolis where users can navigate the city from above the skyline, around and inside of massive high rise buildings and architectural landmarks, through city streets and urban parks, down through underground highways, through a monorail station and even into a multi-level underground subway station. While this map is addictive to fly in Freestyle mode, we've included expert-designed Basic, Medium, and Hard tracks to accompany this new map; Let's see who can stay atop the Leaderboards on these fresh tracks!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29022929/7b0dde8e8a5170570b110d3c9737d5d7f51defb8.jpg
The new Search & Destroy game mode provides a fun and satisfying gameplay experience of destroying target balloons by flying into them. Target balloons of various shapes and sizes are strategically and creatively placed throughout the DRL Sim signature Campground map, along with "danger" balloons that must be avoided, empowering newer pilots with a fun way to level up their skills to begin competing on the more challenging race courses.  

For experienced pilots, Search & Destroy provides a fresh game experience for fine tuning their stick coordination for precision drone control, while also introducing new leaderboards to grind by attempting to "pop" all target balloons in the shortest amount of time. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29022929/74eda0d951e3d439278143ea412f5026e3a3ebde.jpg
The new Onboarding game flow guides newer pilots through a series of progressive training missions and instruction. Pilots will start Onboarding training in an assisted flight Beginner mode completing nine (9) Onboarding missions culminating in a race before progressing to Intermediate, a partially assisted Onboarding flight mode, consisting of 10 missions culminating in another race. Finally,  in Onboarding Pro Mode, pilots will fly unassisted (training wheels completely off) for three (3) races that must be won in sequence to complete Onboarding flight training!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29022929/929b7243fe000c583dfda3872c45653ef3f09277.jpg
The DRL Racer4 is now upgraded to include a throttle cap and battery resistance, with an optional damage setting, to match the setup used by professional DRL pilots during Virtual Season Levels. This allows users to truly train like the pros!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29022929/c761c27bcbedfd7e190d5c5512060e709ee9850c.jpg
This release also unleashes an updated Replay system that uses less RAM while supporting longer Replay recordings. All users will benefit from the faster pre and post race load times, especially when racing with opponent bots. 

Additionally, we've expanded Map Editor capability to support creation of the new Search & Destroy tracks and added a new Geometric Layout tool that enables exponentially faster placement and sizing of large groupings of specific assets in random or pattern configurations.  

We love hearing all feedback and suggestions, so please let us know what you think of this release!

*** Note that with the addition of DRL Pilot mode updates to the stock Racer4, we must reset our Leaderboards with this release and the Replay v2 upgrade is not backwards compatible. For users that update to the v4.0 version, this just means that there will be fresh Leaderboards to top! However, make sure all your friends also update to v4.0, as users that haven't updated from v3.12 will lose the ability to set leaderboard entries, view the replays, and fly against bots ***

Notable Bug Fixes:
- Resolved Leaderboard search issues
- Fixed Tournament system Sudden Death and Golden Heat issues
- Improved overall Tournament system stability
- Enabled Drone crash recordings in Replays
- Resolved Replay system performance issues  
- Rendering improvements on low quality settings to make maps look more consistent
- Exposure calibration on low quality settings to fix either too dark or high exposure maps rendering
- Continued improving console rendering performance for most maps

notes.title: DRL SIM 3.11 Release Announcement
notes.content:
Hello Pilots,

We have another exciting release for you today. We are starting off with our new circuits feature, a campaign mode type of experience. There are 6 new racing circuits for you to fly with each offering 5 race tracks where you will earn a cumulative time after completing all of the tracks in a circuit. You also have the option to race against a bot inspired by a DRL pilot at 4 different difficulty levels. You can see how you stack up with the new circuits leaderboard filter. 

We also are including several community requests in this release including the ability to toggle off drone trails, making the breadcrumbs menus clickable, adding a random option to multiplayer map selection, and adding an option for resetting all of your leaderboard entries.

A release would not be complete without bug fixes. You can find a list of those fixes below.

Please let us know what you think of the release. We are always looking to improve and are open to your feedback. Thanks for your ongoing support of the sim.

notes.title: DRL SIM 3.9 Release Announcement
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29022929/c4ec2b694e1f25964a6a9c4049c7fd784e3fbf61.png
Hello Pilots,
We are excited to bring you our latest update. We start off with a number of big updates courtesy of the U.S. Air Force. The first big update is the introduction of the oft-requested Night Mode, a version of the U.S. Air Force Boneyard at Davis-Monthan Base, with night lighting featuring 3 brand new race tracks. The U.S. Air Force also brings you a number of new features when you are creating your own drones including a rebranded workbench, 3 new U.S. Air Force branded skins, and 2 U.S. Air Force branded motors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29022929/2c361354733e8b25df5d68132d6a842770dc2b68.png
In addition to the U.S. Air Force Boneyard Night Mode, we are bringing you our most graphically advanced map to date, the Campground. This map features a lake, cabins, power lines, cars, bridges, and even a train tunnel for you to fly through. We are kicking off the launch of this map with 4 new tracks for it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29022929/ff438fd2d0b909b7fecb1e48a75a67813d6809e3.png
Next up we have our paid skins feature where we are bringing you our first animated drone skins available for purchase. You can check out these skins under the new “Store” card where you will find skins like “Party Time,” a celebratory skin decked out with animated confetti. Our initial launch includes 2 individual skins available for purchase as well as a pack of 4 skins.

In our last update, we mentioned that our experience points system was being released as a beta. Today, we are simplifying that system where you will have a cumulative level and a weekly level.

We are also adding 3 new achievements today. You can now earn an achievement by winning 5 tournaments, creating 5 maps, and/or building maps that see at least 20 leaderboard times logged on them. 

We’ve heard a number of community requests to add more statistics to the sim. To this end, you will now find information on your fastest lap, slowest lap, number of crashes, and finish percentile (relative to your time on the leaderboard). 

Lastly, we have included a number of improvements including more work on the race line system as well as bug fixes. You can find a complete list of those below.

As always, your feedback and ongoing support are valued. Please let us know what you think of this release as we are constantly striving to bring you the best simulator that we can.

  
Bug Fixes

 Corrected issues with World Traveler achievement
 Resolved problems with camera boxes appearing on tracks
 Reverted multiplayer forced Racer4 default changes to resolved bugs
 Made Bridge map accessible in Map Editor
 Resolved issue with drone rotation on rates screen
 Resolved problems with various loading animations not working/loading
 Fixed problem with network disconnected dialogue message going out of box

notes.title: DRL Sim 3.8 Release Announcement
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29022929/8c5d494ed8232d6d8957570b9cc1f7040a38b994.jpg

Hello Pilots,

You’ve been waiting patiently for the next set of features to come out and today we bring you a monster of a release. 

We start off with two features that have been highly requested - Offline mode and a Favorite System. Yes, you can now play the sim offline when you are traveling or don’t have an internet connection. You can also now put all of your favorite tracks in a single folder, eliminating the need to navigate through multiple menus in between races to find the track you want to race.

Next, we bring you a custom bot feature and bot improvements. For the custom bot feature, you can now race against any player you want from the leaderboard. You can build a field of up to 5 pilots to race against with the new “custom” option in solo race. For the bot improvements, we bring you a default of racing against DRL Racer 4 bots. In the past, you would get matched up against drones from all classes so we wanted to make the competition more even by default.

We are still going strong here with the features as we bring you an achievement system on Steam. You now have 15 achievements that you can earn. You will earn badges based on the achievements you earn.

We also bring you a new track called the Foundry Circuit on Boston Foundry.

The monster release would not be complete without one more major feature. It is our experience points system. You will earn a level over the course of all of your flying based on the tracks you fly (Each DRL track now shows XP and you earn more XP for multiplayer races). You will also earn streak points for every day when you fly 3 DRL tracks. No experience points system would be complete without a badge system, which is reset every week. You can find more details in the sim under “About XP.” Please note that this is in beta and will be adjusted on our next release based on findings. Since we are launching on a Thursday, the weekly ranking (with badges) will reset on Monday as Monday marks the start of the new week.

Please let us know your thoughts. We always appreciate your feedback and are thankful for the engaged community we have that always pushes us further to deliver the best sim we can.

Selecting ‘New Drone’ in Make Drones will now allow you to select any of your custom drones in addition to the DRL Default drones to use as a starting point.

Optimized the Sim to use less memory where possible.
Fixed an issue where the the first checkpoint wouldn’t activate properly when restarting races. 
Resolved issue with Leaderboard standings not updating post race when flying against ghosts.

notes.title: DRL Sim Hotfix for Update 2.9

notes.content:

Hello Pilots,

In preparation for our next two Race2Vegas events on Twitch (tonight January 10th and next Thursday January 17th) as well as our efforts to continuously improve the Sim, we are bringing you a new update today. 

Maps and Courses
We are leading off this update with 2 great 2018 DRL Season Maps - Allianz Riviera and BMW Welt. These two unique maps are now available for Race, Freestyle, and use in the Map Editor. Additionally, this release brings a new course that can be found under “Simple Courses” called “Morning Cruise.”

Multiplayer Improvements

Hello Pilots, 
We’ve got a new update for you all that improves upon a few of the things we introduced in the last update. Here’s what you can expect from DRL Simulator Version 2.2 

Changing Drones: 

We’ve made it easier to change drones during any of our events or activities. You can now change your drone directly through the pause menu without having to go back to the map screen. Be aware that this will restart your current race and change the race class accordingly. 

Physics Dashboard Improvements: 

In addition to some overall tweaking, we have enabled the Physics Dashboard to be accessed from any mode in the game. Players can set and save physics properties for their custom drones on the fly. Please note that race times with your own physics will be marked different from default physics times in order to keep things fair. 

Here’s how it works: 

In race or freestyle you must open the Physics Dashboard from the pause menu at which point your run will be tagged as a ‘Custom Physics’ run until you hit a loading screen and it resets, unless you have a ‘Tuned’ drone but we’ll get to that later. 

Hitting the ‘P’ key now will bring up the dashboard like in the ‘Physics’ level. 

In the Physics Dashboard you can ‘Save’ your current settings you have set to your drone that you are using, the drone then becomes ‘Tuned’. Hitting ‘Clear’ will reset your drone back to default settings. Selecting ‘New’ at the top will save your drone as a community drone, more on that in future updates.

DRL Leaders leaderboard is for stock parts on a default tuned DRL Racer3. Don’t worry, you can still go nuts with the cosmetics and still be official.


If you have any other questions, please leave them in the comments below.

Bugs and Performance: 

We’re hard at work improving the overall experience of the game, we’ve focused this update on improving our quality settings and performance of the game along with general bug fixes. If you’re having any trouble with the SIM or just want to know more, please see our helpdesk  


Thanks everyone!

Hello pilots,

The latest version of the DRL Simulator has just been released. This release adds: 

• The DRL 2017 World Championship map. Test your skills on the track that determined a champion.

• The Pitch/Roll slider in the Controller Sensitivity menu can now be separated. You can find the option to separate in the Game Settings menu.

Map

2017 World Championship Map has been added.

Multiplayer

Force Race/Spectate feature has been added. Room hosts can now define pilot roles before a race starts if needed.
Kick Player feature has been added, players can now vote to kick a player.
Ready feature has been added. Multiplayer will now start when all players have marked themselves ready.

Physics

BetaFlight rates have been stabilized. Rates now more closely match BetaFlight with minimal variance.
Improved feedback and readability on tuning screen.
The Pitch/Roll slider in the Controller Sensitivity menu can now be separated. The separate sliders option can be found in the Game Settings menu.

Missions

General bug fixes and enhancements have been made across all missions.

Bugs

A bug affecting the right stick of the Nikko Air Elite 115 controller has been fixed.
A bug that caused the drone to be missing from the lost signal animation has been fixed.

notes.title: 🐁DRL Simulator has been updated to ver 2.0.2999🐁
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29022929/27ec3825966fcf1299342ce3e0b24eff32fc705f.png

Hello pilots,

The latest version of the DRL Simulator has just been released. This release adds: 

• Physics have received improvements. Rates are being refined to more closely match BetaFlight, we ask that players check rc/expo rates and tune to preference. This applies to all drones.

• Mouse support. This highly requested feature finally returns to the sim.

• Soft reset is now available in training missions. And the option to give direct feedback on missions has been added as well.

PLEASE NOTE: THE DEV TEAM HAS ISOLATED THE RACER3 FROM ALL PHYSICS CHANGES TO MAINTAIN THE INTEGRITY OF THE 2018 SWATCH DRL TRYOUTS.

As always all feedback is welcomed and encouraged, please share your thoughts with us in the discussion section.

Release notes follow below:

Physics

Rates are being refined to more closely match BetaFlight, pilots should check rc/expo rates and tune to preference. This applies to all drones.
Various general improvements have been made to physics.

UI

Mouse functionality has been added, players can navigate the sim with their mouse.
A bug that caused the page numbers and navigation arrows for the Tryouts Leaderboard to be unavailable has been resolved.
Corrected an issue where the sim would continue to run when Alt-Tab'd.
Stars will now only appear at the end of Training missions when a star has been earned, as intended.

Multiplayer

Drone to drone collisions have been disabled in Multiplayer Mode. 
Various multiplayer bugs have been solved, included random framerate drops, and an audio bug that caused certain audio to continue to run after the end of a match.

Missions

The ability to soft reset during training missions has been added.
Feedback UI has been added for players to share their opinions with the team.
Improvements based on community and Dev Team feedback have been applied.

Bugs

Improvements based on community feedback

notes.title: DRL Simulator has been updated to ver 2.0.b262
notes.content:
The latest version of the DRL Simulator has just been released. This is a hotfix release that addresses a bug that players encountered in training missions in Quests 1 and 2. Because it wouldn't allow the sim to register player interaction with specific flags, the bug would make it impossible to complete certain missions. This is now fixed.

The dev team has included a fix to physics in the questlines, as well as an audio fix. Details about these fixes, can be found in the release notes below.

I'd like to say thank you to the community, who helped bring the flag bug to the team's attention. Your feedback is invaluable. Please continue to share your feedback with us in the discussion section. As always all feedback is welcomed and encouraged.

Release notes follow below:

Hotfixes

Fixed an issue where motor audio continued to be head after the end of a race
Fixed issues related to physics for beginner mode missions
Fixed issues preventing the completion of the following missions in Quests 1 and 2: Square Route, Star Road, Rising Sun and Balloon Hunt

notes.title: DRL High Voltage is now the DRL Simulator!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29022929/95e57d41175f526c8e345d5b607d87fd7e598aa1.png

Hello Pilots,

Now that DRL High Voltage's Early Access has come to a close, the sim enters full release as: the DRL Simulator. Starting today the DRL Simulator will be available for purchase from the Steam store for $19.99. Early Access players can purchase at the discounted price of $14.99 until December 1, 2017 from within the game. No new download will be necessary, just follow the onscreen prompts from the Purchase menu.

The DRL Simulator offers players the best full featured FPV racing simulation on the market. Already a pilot? Head over to multiplayer and compete against the world's best players. Just want to practice? Sharpen your skills in freestyle. Interested to see how you'd do on a real DRL race track? Test your mettle on maps modeled on real world courses featured in the 2016 and 2017 seasons of the Drone Racing League. Never flown a drone in your life, but always wanted to learn? Try the ever expanding training quests, packed with missions designed to take any player from rookie to rockstar.

Starting on November 15, 2017, the 2018 DRL TRYOUTS will launch exclusively from the all new DRL Simulator. Compete against pilots from around the world, all while vying for a chance to earn a contract to race as a professional DRL Pilot in the 2018 season.

And coming this December, tweak and customize your drones in your very own Drone Workshop. Drones like the Racer2, Racer3, Hedwig, Mifune, and Tweaker.

It's time to join the challenging, but rewarding, world of FPV racing. Welcome to the DRL Simulator.

Release notes follow below:

Maps

Munich Playoffs


UI

Purchase card/menu for Early Access players, allows Early Access players to unlock the full game
Drone Selection on Multiplayer Room Screen


Missions

5 star scoring system


Replay

0-9 Keyboard shortcuts for selecting targets
Improvements on camera input for video capture


Multiplayer

Drone selection for Freestyle/Race
Major improvement to Interpolation (Much smoother now, even with coarse pings)
Room Master can now spectate


Bugs

Several fixes and improvements from community feedback

notes.title: DRL High Voltage has been updated to ver 2.0.506e-eax
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29022929/d7c86c99a62a141e418a57733feb35b4f0550af9.png

Hello Pilots,

The latest version of DRL High Voltage has just been released. This release fulfills one of our most requested features: Multiplayer.

Multiplayer allows pilots to race other pilots, head to head, in real time. If you get a chance to try it out, let us know what you think. This update also brings with it a scoring system which will give players feedback when completing missions in quest lines. You'll now be able to see how well you stack up against other players.

The team has also added 4 new drones to Freestyle and Single Player races. You'll now be able to freestyle or race (in single player) with the Racer2, Racer3, Hedwig, Mifune, and Tweaker!

These, as well as other updates are listed in the release notes below. Be sure to let us know what you think in the discussion section. All feedback is welcomed and encouraged.

Release notes follow below:

General
Improved drone reset postioning in races
Re-tuned physics parameters for more realistic flight feel and behavior
Physics are still being tuned, anticipate further improvements in the next update



Multiplayer

Create Race or Freestyle rooms to fly with the community

Freestyle

Up to 12 Players and 12 spectators can participate simultaneously
Switch between flying and spectating during game play

Race

Up to 6 racers and 6 spectators
Persistent room (race as much you want without switching rooms)
Vote for the next random track when enabled on the room
Penalty system for rage-quitters



Missions

5 Star Based Scoring system added


Input

Controller profiles can now be edited or deleted without the controller connected


Audio

New music for Project Manhattan has been added


Bugs

Several fixes and improvements from community feedback

Hello Pilots,

The latest version of DRL High Voltage has just been released. This release brings two big features to the game.

The Opponents System will let pilots race the ghosts of the Top 5 pilots, or the 5 pilots closest to them on the leaderboards, or a mix of the two. Pilots will also be able take on the challenge of racing the ghost of the overall number one pilot on the leaderboards. And be able to race their own leaderboard ghosts as well.

Expo tuning has been high on the list of requests from a lot of pilots and is included in this update. A lot of you will have opinions on this feature, keep in mind that the game is still in early release, so please be sure to share your feedback with the team in the discussion section. As always: feedback is welcomed and encouraged.

New training missions have also been added, including 5 new Pro Mode missions. This, as well as other updates are listed in the release notes below.

Release notes follow below:

Race

Opponents System

Self: Race your past leaderboard ghost
Top 5: Race Top 5 leaderboard ghosts
Rival 5: Race the 5 Player's ghosts around you on leaderboards
Random 5: Race a mix of Top 5 and Rival 5



Missions

Overall missions fixes

Enable/Disable visual elements from HUD and other screens
Enable/Disable Controller Overlay

Added expo to controller tuning

notes.title: DRL High Voltage has been updated to ver 2.0.ddfd-eax
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29022929/49e7bb8f138ceb8931c3bc8da83f3c82552971f9.png
Hello Pilots,

The latest version of DRL High Voltage has just been released. This update introduces the Nikko Drone 220!

The result of a collaboration between DRL and Nikko, the DRL High Voltage is the best starter drone for any new pilot. This is why, starting with this update, it will be the featured drone for all Training Missions. This update also includes support for the Nikko controller, allowing owners of the Nikko Drone 220 to use the included transmitter as a controller for the game. Audio and graphical enhancements have also been added. A full list can be found in the attached release notes.

Be sure to let us know what you think in the discussion section. Remember: all feedback is welcomed and encouraged.

Release notes follow below:

UI

Nikko drone overlays for training and controller setup


Input

Nikko drone support
FCProfileData includes Nikko presets
Included Logitech F310 and Interlink Realflight help sections


Missions

Nikko drone is now the default drone in-game


Settings

Resolution detection tweaks in the Hardware score system 
Lower than 800x600 resolutions excluded from options


Audio

Propeller sound improvements
Wind noise temporarily removed

notes.title: DRL High Voltage has been updated to ver 2.0.5593-eax
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29022929/4837b408b86e28a2bbdf28adbf050252482b56cc.png
Hello Pilots,

The latest version of DRL High Voltage has just been released. This update resolves a lot of the controller issues that players have encountered and increases the amount of controllers that are compatible with the game. This includes Taranis, Flysky, and Spektrum, as well many other transmitters.

Adjustments to flight controls are also improved for controllers and drone physics. The team has also added ‘Campaign Mode’, where players are challenged to earn the best aggregated time across multiple tracks and will appear on the leaderboards.  Details on other improvements can be found in the release notes.

Be sure to let us know what you think in the discussion section. Remember: all feedback is welcomed and encouraged.

Release notes follow below:

Campaign Mode

Race several tracks to do the best aggregated time
New leaderboards for Campaigns

Graphics

Radio Signal effect can be toggled(fallbacks to UI notification)

Physics

Flight characteristics improved

UI

Race Complete results animation a bit more faster  
3D Drone Preview on Tuning/Physics screen
Hardware detection to auto tune graphics

Audio

New Props Sound
Wind sound during high speed/fast rotation

Taranis QX7
FS-SM600

notes.title: DRL: High Voltage has been updated to version 2.0.11ae0-eax
notes.content:
Hello pilots,

The latest version of DRL High Voltage is now available, so be sure to update your game and get flying.

What are the additions?  RACE MODE and LEADERBOARDS are now available to all pilots. It's time to get out there and show off those skills. Keyboard controls have been restored. Some other improvements include better controller compatibility and all around flight control. So if you've had any issues with this in the previous release, be sure to check this update out.

The dev team recommends that all players delete their current controller configurations and re-calibrate their controllers, after they have updated, to ensure you can take full advantage of this update.

The team is really excited to get this release out to you all! Be sure to let us know what you think in the discussion section. Remember: all feedback is welcomed and encouraged.

Release notes follow below:

Input

	Keyboard input always enabled
	RC Switches Available
	Drone Reset
	Race Reset
	New [Low Med High] Presets tailored for each controller

Racer3 Specs raised

    5S
    6040 3 Blade
    1650g Thrust

Flight Controller improvements

	Air Mode fixes
	Better PID balancing
	Strange oscilations on higher throttle fixed
	Improper yaw behaviour fixed
	Tuning Parameters are now Auto-Saved (removed Save button)

Race Mode enabled

	New Drone intro to present racing drones 
	Music improvements
	Slowmotion feature for race completion and audio

Leaderboards

	Time tracking for Race Mode
	Screen showing Times + Controller used per Map/Track

UI

	Increased the number of supported resolutions
	Keyboard navigation improved
	Sliders now work properly with the keyboard
	Improved elements focus feedback
	Backspace now return screens
	PageUp and PageDown select Next/Prev items on pickers
	FCMode is now stored between sessions

Missions

	Bug fixes and improvements

Fixes

	Tuning unmatched curves/values

notes.title: RC Transmitter/controller issue UPDATE!
notes.content:
DRL High Voltage - v2.0.275-eax

Hello pilots,

As most of you are aware, at launch, High Voltage had some controller issues that made the game challenging to play. Since then, the dev team has been hard at work on a solution and I am happy to announce that these issues have been resolved and an update is now available!

Please update your game to the latest version 2.0.275-eax and take your drone out for a spin!

Thank you all for your patience during this bumpy time and for all your feedback and support!

Happy flying!
